verdict.rationale: Installing an OS on a user's existing machine is a fair question for an operating system, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only describes setting up a new Mac and transferring files from a PC with Migration Assistant, or running Windows on a Mac. Nothing documents installing macOS in place of a switcher's current OS on the same hardware.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can install the OS in place of my current OS on the same machine
